title: Jukebox Redstone Control
description: This mixins into the Jukebox and makes it so redstone can logarithmically change volume. For example a level of 15 is 0% volume and level 0 is 100% volume.
body:
### DISCLAIMER 
> This may or may not work on just the client, theoretically it should, but some features will be limited like the syncing of some things, like a lectern being able to change the strength and therefor the volume. This is because a mixing on the server was required to save the data and send a packet to the client based on the data.

This mixins into the Jukebox and makes it so redstone can logarithmically change volume. For example a level of 15 is 0% volume and level 0 is 100% volume. Simple mod I made in a single day, so expect bugs.

Also please go check out the main more I have been working on, called, BTC, which stands for Better Trial Chambers. It adds a fully fledged magic system, puzzles, and WIP lore. This might be biased, but from asking my friends and other people it does seem to feel like vanilla+ as it gets to connect low to a larger system, and tries to slowly introduce you into it, for example, with little camp grounds as surface indicators which themselves will contain lore connecting you further into the mod. Go check it out at, [BTC | Better Trial Chambers](https://modrinth.com/mod/btc)
